newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican cabbie returns $53,000 cash left in taxi.
newsitem.headline: Mexican cabbie returns $53,000 cash left in taxi.

text.p: A Mexican taxi driver said on Monday he returned $53,000 in cash that a passenger had left in his cab to its rightful owner, a Bolivian senator.
Manuel Lubian, a father of two who drives a battered green Volkswagen "beetle," said he turned down a reward from the senator.
"I felt that (if I accepted the reward) I would lose the beauty inside of me," he said on the Televisa TV nightly news programme.
Lubian spent two days recently searching Mexico City hotels for his passenger, who had left the cash, jewels and important papers in a briefcase on the cab's back seat.
Bolivia's ambassador to Mexico, Oscar Arce Quintanilla, wrote to Televisa to commend the cabbie.
